caveats: Priorities in this report derive from static analysis thresholds that have NOT been calibrated (VM-OQ-06). Treat P0/P1 routing as provisional: the thresholds are the specification's defaults and are expected to be noisy until shadow-run data has been reviewed.

SLA figures in this report are measured against PROVISIONAL remediation windows (VM-OQ-02 is unanswered): the windows are the specification's working defaults and have not been agreed with the teams they bind. A breach here means "older than an unreviewed window", not "late against a commitment".
Blast radius is recorded but does not influence priority (VM-OQ-12 is unanswered), so a vulnerability in a widely consumed shared module may rank below one confined to a single repository.
